defs.def: one more time; on another occasion 再一次；又一次

ex.s: We learn, adjust, and try again.
ex.t: 我们学习、调整，然后再试一次。

ex.s: Then it starts all over again the next month.
ex.t: 然后下个月一切又重新开始。

ex.s: If I ever get trapped outside my house again, my local telephone box will, sadly, no longer be able to connect me with my keys.
ex.t: 如果我再被锁在屋外，可悲的是，我家附近的电话亭将不再能帮我联系到钥匙了。

ex.s: So I was actually reading it again, but what I was rereading seemed entirely new.
ex.t: 所以我其实是在重读它，但我重读的内容似乎完全是全新的。

ex.s: After that, I would never call Miss Chevalier “Poodle” again.
ex.t: 从那以后，我再也不会叫谢瓦利埃小姐“贵宾犬”了。

ex.s: Again, a black box.
ex.t: 又是一个黑箱。

ex.s: Now, write it again.” I wrote it again, and again and again.

ex.s: Now, write it again.” I wrote it again, and again and again.

ex.s: She again looked directly into my eyes, then let out a squeaking call and was gone.
ex.t: 她再次直视我的眼睛，然后发出一声尖细的叫声便离开了。

ex.s: A few weeks later, I went to the farm again.
ex.t: 几周后，我再次去了那个农场。

ex.s: As another winter sets in, I’m more than ready to embrace the cold again.
ex.t: 当又一个冬天来临时，我已经准备好再次拥抱寒冷了。

ex.s: To lift her spirits again.
ex.t: 重新振作精神。

ex.s: For the “unable” scenario, the experimenter would again move the treat towards the hole while the dog watched, but “accidentally” drop it before they could pass it through.
ex.t: 在“无能为力”的情形中，实验者会再次当着狗的面把零食移向小孔，但在穿过小孔之前“不小心”把它掉在了地上。

ex.s: apply to the original project againD. put his heart and soul into the lab work

ex.s: He tried again.

ex.s: Then you can print out a fresh draft, again setting your text on triple-space.
ex.t: 然后你可以打印一份新草稿，再次将文本设为三倍行距。

ex.s: “Again, Daddy, again!” Jacky shouts as I throw him skywards and catch him on the way back down again.
ex.t: “再一次，爸爸，再一次！”杰基喊道，我把他扔向天空，在回来的路上又抓住了他。

ex.s: Then we began again.
ex.t: 然后我们重新开始。

ex.s: Or perhaps a design works so well it is adopted elsewhere again and again, with seemingly harmless improvements, until, suddenly, it does not work at all anymore.
ex.t: 或者也许一个设计如此出色，以至于被其他地方反复采用，并进行了看似无害的改进，直到突然它完全不起作用了。

ex.s: 38   You will make mistakes, time and time again.

ex.s: Then I can spare some time to learn it again, such that we can practice together on every day.
ex.t: 然后，我可以腾出一些时间再次学习它，这样我们就可以每天一起练习。

ex.s: —The machine is working again!
ex.t: —机器又能工作了！

ex.s: So I try again and tug at the heartstrings.
ex.t: 所以我又试了一次，打动她的情感。

ex.s: Last winter when I went here again, they had a big separate house to raise dozens of chicken.
ex.t: 去年冬天我再去了一次，他们有了一间独立的大屋，养了几十只鸡。

ex.s: Holker once again opens its gardens in aid of the disadvantaged.
ex.t: 旅游业现在是道森城的主要产业——其目前人口为762人。

ex.s: Despite the pain, I stayed the course walking a bit and then running again.
ex.t: 尽管疼痛，我坚持了下来，走了一会儿然后又跑起来。

ex.s: “I gave up hope of finding my ring again," she says.
ex.t: "我已经放弃找到我的戒指的希望了，"她说。

ex.s: But a minute later, it was by his side again.
ex.t: 但一分钟后，它又来到他身边。

ex.s: In a recycling economy, we would make one set of 100 cans to start with, then replace them over and over again with recycled cans.
ex.t: 在一个循环回收经济中，我们会先制造一组100个罐子，然后再用回收的罐子反复替换它们。

ex.s: Who knew if we’d ever see them again?
ex.t: 谁知道我们是否会再见到他们？

ex.s: Breaking up firms like Google into five small ones would not stop remaking themselves: in time, one of them would become great again.
ex.t: 像谷歌这样的公司即使被拆分成五家小公司，也无法阻止它们重新崛起：迟早其中一家会再次壮大。

ex.s: I'll make her scrambled eggs again, and this time they won't be burnt!
ex.t: 我再给她做个炒蛋，这次不烧了！

ex.s: But something inside me was going to climb that mountain at all cost． I could hardly wait to try this adventure again．
ex.t: 但我内心有股力量要不惜一切代价去爬那座山。我迫不及待地想再试一次这次冒险。

ex.s: Well, thanks again for coming to speak to us, Lisa.
ex.t: 再次感谢您前来与我们交谈，丽莎。

ex.s: (Son enters room.) Father: Not again!

ex.s: It felt great to know that I had helped bring this family together again.
ex.t: 知道自己帮助这个家庭重新团聚，感觉太棒了。

ex.s: I am down there in my wheelchair in the morning letting the hens out and down there again at night to see they’ve gone to bed.”

ex.t: 如今，它们再次成为一道熟悉的风景，扮演着对社区来说往往与其最初用途同样重要的角色。

ex.s: Well, we agreed that night that we would meet here again exactly twenty years from that date and time, no matter what our conditions might be or from what distance we might have to come.
ex.t: 好吧，那天晚上我们同意，无论我们的条件如何，或者我们可能要走多远，我们都会在那个日期和时间整整二十年后再次在这里见面。

defs.def: （引出相对照的事实或看法）再说，另一方面

ex.s: The story once again tells us that one good turn deserves another.
ex.t: 这个故事再次告诉我们，一个好的转折值得另一个转折。

ex.s: I texted him and expressed wishes for him to come out again.
ex.t: 这些可爱的小猎手只是在做它们从远古时代起就刻在本能里的事情。

ex.s: This was an aha moment for me, and I never thought about endings the same way again.
ex.t: 这对我是个恍然大悟的时刻，此后我对结局的看法再也不同。

ex.s: I read both definitions over again, trying to figure it out, but Miss Chevalier must have read my mind.
